headline.text: L2 ML2 fought jams past metal detector for *4 hours* — finally stable at 12:40, plus L1 scrambled on a Celtic salt shortage that forced a product switch.

per_plant_summary.L1: S1 ran pretzels with a cam-setting fix on MM10. S2 changed to NIC dark caramel and hit chocolate tank capacity, will use drums. S3 finished one order, caustic-cleaned, and started the next. S4 ran salt & caramel but scrambled when Celtic salt ran out — switched to CRU for the remainder.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 spent the morning battling jams and door faults, finally stable after lunch. ML3 ran chocolate bars with recurring label-roll issues. FFS and panning ran smoothly aside from a missing LPN in staging.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 ran Hershey trial (Janell: Hershey super pleased), then cleaned for next product. Truffle line reheated overnight, fixed wire mesh at 06:42, ran all day. ML4 deep-cleaned for format change. MFM toggled between BEQ Canada and Assorted after schedule confusion.

notes.text: Hershey zero sugar toffee trial exceeded expectations — Janell thanked the team at 19:31.
Zack found emergency exit blocked by barrels (one leaking oil) at start of third shift — team cleared and cleaned.
Pretzel thins arriving 8 layers high instead of 5 due to special shipments; December deliveries should return to normal stack height.

resolved.title: Celtic salt shortage forced S4 product change
resolved.summary: Only 3 bags Celtic salt remaining for S4, inventory shows 820 lbs vs 1,657 expected, no more inbound before run end.
resolved.resolution: Switched product at 08:35 — changed S4 to CRU (which has all materials), new WO 2,592 cases (Daniel Bringas).

resolved.title: S1 MM10 not opening pouches
resolved.summary: MM10 cam setting window too narrow (90-150 vs MM9's 350-150), failing to detect pouch pickup.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:54 — changed MM10 to match MM9 settings, "working well now" (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S3 C19 belt sensor regulator damaged
resolved.summary: Regulator for sensor on C19 belt failed, maintenance searching for spare parts.

resolved.title: S2 weighing machine decimal issue on new product
resolved.summary: Recipe for new product can't set 23.4g (reverts to 23.0), using 23.5g instead — 0.1g difference from spec.
resolved.resolution: Approved at 17:16 — Charity Young authorized the 0.1g variance (Angelica Perez).

resolved.title: Emergency exit blocked by barrels
resolved.summary: Multiple pallets of barrels blocking L2 emergency exit at third-shift start, one barrel cracked and leaking oil.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:52 — team contained spill, cleaned area, and cleared exit immediately (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: ML2 jams past metal detector
resolved.summary: Line fought jams and door faults from 09:13 through lunch, maintenance adjusted sensor b299 and long belts, slowed speed to 10.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:40 — "as of 12:40 the line is running a lot better" (Alex Mendoza at 13:08).

resolved.title: Internet down at L2
resolved.resolution: Restored at 12:32 — "It is working for me again" (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: Truffle bottomer wire mesh damaged
resolved.summary: Wire belt damaged at 05:58, maintenance (Kavin, Jose) called immediately.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 06:42 — "Wire mesh has been fixed" (Jose Vasquez).

resolved.title: ML4 cold stamps found dirty
resolved.summary: Cold stamps discovered dirty at 12:13 during changeover setup.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned and passed at 13:08 — "Cold stamp pass visual and ATP" (Kevin Del Valle).

resolved.title: ML1 wrapper machine cover missing
resolved.summary: Wrapping machine roll cover missing, employee noticed while wrapping scrap pallets.
resolved.resolution: Located at 16:29 — part taken to fix MFM wrapper but not used due to bent roller, can swap back (Tyson Fausett).

needs_attention.status: Foreign material detected and rejected by X-Ray; no investigation or source identified by window close.

needs_attention.status: Samples collected and flagged to Dakota, Charity, Conner, Elizabeth; no analysis results by window close.

needs_attention.status: Adjustments made at 16:36, will advise when conditions improve, but no update by window close.

needs_attention.status: Line paused to clean at 07:39, resumed later, but root cause (why skipped in changeover) not addressed.
